img.caption: Fig 7: Ablation studies. (a) k_max=1 is optimal: expanding auxiliary intents beyond the top-1 degrades set IoU on multi-intent data. (b) fusion weight alpha=0.1 minimises ECE on both single- and multi-intent data; either pure retrieval or pure LLM confidence is poorly calibrated. (c) K_r=1 (top-1 retrieval) produces tighter and more accurate sets than K_r=5.

Fig 8: Knowledge-base update simulation on CLINC150. New intents unseen by the KB are 100% rejected (coverage 0.0, false-reject 99.2%); adding them to the KB restores coverage to ~0.87 without retraining, confirming the training-free update path.
